_comment: Authored analysis: ownership, lifecycle, refcount and locking judgements that no composer can derive, keyed to the C entities they describe. The structural half of each record (field layout, signatures, footprints, casts) is composed from the CodeQL tables on demand and merged in at read time, so a re-extract rewrites nothing here. Written only by `wavefront <repo> <target> query {types,symbols} --update`; read through wavefront.manifests. Hand-edit at your own risk: `--update` validates a submission against the composed skeleton (unknown field, wrong kind, ptr-invariant violation) and this file does not.

ptr.note: Trailing component, read for the call only. NULL makes the result av_strdup(path); both NULL yields NULL.
Leading path, read for the call only. NULL makes the result av_strdup(component).

Fresh NUL-terminated join of path and component with exactly one '/' between them (av_malloc, or av_strdup when one side is NULL); released by av_free. NULL when both are NULL, on size_t overflow or on allocation failure.
printf format, read for the call only (vsnprintf twice); the variadic arguments follow it. Must not be NULL.
Fresh av_malloc(len + 1) block holding the formatted, NUL-terminated string; released by av_free. NULL when vsnprintf fails or allocation fails.

Array of nmemb elements of size bytes, ZEROED (av_mallocz); also one zeroed object when nmemb is 1 (av_calloc(1, sizeof(RNNModel)) in libavfilter/af_arnndn.c, av_calloc(1, sizeof(*fc->ft)) in libavcodec/vvc/thread.c). NULL also when nmemb*size overflows size_t. Fresh av_malloc storage: posix_memalign(ALIGN) with ALIGN = 64/32/16 by SIMD config (16 is the floor); size 0 yields a 1-byte block, so NULL means failure: size > max_alloc_size (INT_MAX by default, av_max_alloc) or OOM. Released by av_free/av_freep.

Releases any block from the av_malloc family (av_malloc/mallocz/calloc/malloc_array/memdup/realloc*/strdup): free(), or _aligned_free with HAVE_ALIGNED_MALLOC. NULL is a no-op. Type-erased: one object or an array of any element type; never reads the contents. Also the releaser of every NUL-terminated string the family returns (av_strdup, av_strndup, av_asprintf, av_get_token, av_append_path_component, av_strireplace, av_bprint_finalize's out-string).

Declared void* but is a T** slot (memcpy'd through to dodge aliasing). Reads the pointer held in the slot, stores NULL into the slot, then av_free()s the old pointee (NULL pointee is a no-op). The slot itself is borrowed and must be non-NULL; the pointee's ownership transfers in.

In/out cursor slot (const char **): *buf is a caller-owned NUL-terminated string, read from and then advanced past the token (*buf = p, pointing into the same string, at the first terminator char or the NUL). The callee writes the slot but never the string; `mutable` is false only because the innermost pointee is const. Neither buf nor *buf may be NULL.
Set of terminator characters (strspn), read for the call only. Must not be NULL.

Fresh av_realloc block holding the unescaped, whitespace-trimmed token, NUL-terminated (shrunk with av_realloc when possible); released by av_free. NULL only when the initial av_realloc(NULL, strlen(*buf) + 1) fails, in which case *buf is left unchanged.

NOT zeroed (uninitialised; poisoned with 0x2a only under CONFIG_MEMORY_POISONING). Fresh av_malloc storage: posix_memalign(ALIGN) with ALIGN = 64/32/16 by SIMD config (16 is the floor); size 0 yields a 1-byte block, so NULL means failure: size > max_alloc_size (INT_MAX by default, av_max_alloc) or OOM. Released by av_free/av_freep.

Array of nmemb elements of size bytes, NOT zeroed. NULL also when nmemb*size overflows size_t. Fresh av_malloc storage: posix_memalign(ALIGN) with ALIGN = 64/32/16 by SIMD config (16 is the floor); size 0 yields a 1-byte block, so NULL means failure: size > max_alloc_size (INT_MAX by default, av_max_alloc) or OOM. Released by av_free/av_freep.

ZEROED (av_malloc + memset 0). Fresh av_malloc storage: posix_memalign(ALIGN) with ALIGN = 64/32/16 by SIMD config (16 is the floor); size 0 yields a 1-byte block, so NULL means failure: size > max_alloc_size (INT_MAX by default, av_max_alloc) or OOM. Released by av_free/av_freep.

Read-only source of size bytes, any allocator; only read for the call. NULL source returns NULL. One object as well as an array: av_memdup(ctx, sizeof(DNXHDEncContext)) in libavcodec/dnxhdenc.c and av_memdup(s, slice_size) in libavcodec/mpegvideo.c copy a single context struct.

Fresh av_malloc(size) block holding a byte copy of p (deep clone): one object (the per-thread context copies in dnxhdenc.c / mpegvideo.c) or an array. NULL when p is NULL or allocation fails. size 0 yields a 1-byte block. Released by av_free.
Old block, ownership taken: realloc(ptr, size + !size). On failure (NULL return) the old block is NOT freed and stays owned by the caller. Only malloc alignment (16 on glibc x86_64), not ALIGN.

Resized block; NULL on failure or size > max_alloc_size. realloc-style: releases and reallocates the same slot, so not a constructor (schema); no lifecycle role. The raw-lifetime void tier binds av_free/av_malloc*/av_memdup instead.
Source string, read up to its NUL (strlen + memcpy) for the call only; any allocator. NULL is accepted and yields NULL.

Fresh av_realloc(NULL, strlen(s) + 1) block holding a NUL-terminated copy of s (deep clone), released by av_free. NULL when s is NULL, when the length exceeds av_max_alloc (INT_MAX by default) or on allocation failure. Not av_malloc-aligned (av_realloc).
Needle, matched case-insensitively (av_stristr), read for the call only. Must not be NULL (strlen).
Haystack, read for the call only. Must not be NULL.
Replacement, read for the call only. Must not be NULL (strlen).

Fresh NUL-terminated string from av_bprint_finalize (av_malloc / av_realloc storage, or av_memdup of the internal buffer); released by av_free. NULL when the AVBPrint ran out of memory (incomplete) or finalize fails.

Source bytes, read for the call only: memchr scans at most len bytes for a NUL and the copy stops there, so s is a NUL-terminated string or any buffer of at least len readable bytes (callers pass sub-ranges of larger strings: get_extension, parse_cookie). NULL is accepted and yields NULL.

Fresh av_realloc(NULL, n + 1) block, n = min(len, offset of the first NUL), holding those n bytes plus a NUL (deep clone of a prefix), released by av_free. NULL when s is NULL, n + 1 exceeds av_max_alloc, or allocation fails.
